title.narrative: Strengthening and Consolidation of internal control Framework of Fed Gov't

description.narrative: The Mexican Ministry of Public Administration (SFP) has identified the need to improve the current internal control practices in the public sector, as they function in a reactive rather than a preventive manner, occasioning an inefficient use and protection of the public resources. To this end, the objectives of the requested grant are the following: 1) Build up institutional capacity for the development of a new internal control framework, which needs to be robust enough to face the increasing complexity and challenging operational environment of the federal public administration in Mexico. 2) Strength the existent risk management model with the objective of encouraging a preventive, proactive and self identification approach in internal control matters. 3) Develop adequate expertise in a certain number of public servants for the application of the new internal control methodologies. The objectives of the Project are: (a) to strengthen the institutional capacity of the Ministry of Public Administration (SFP by its Spanish acronym) to implement the new internal control model to address the increasingly complex and challenging operating environment faced by the public sector entities; (b) strength SFP existent risk management model to promote a preventive, proactive and self identification approach to internal control matters; and (c) to promote the development of appropriate institutional skills in the public sector employees for the implementation of the new internal control model.
